title: Allowed apps for the assistant
scope: Persona remembers these computer-app approvals on the manager, even when this computer is offline or control is off. Agent tools with separate computer-use permissions are managed separately.
denied: You do not have permission to manage remembered computer-app approvals.
unsupported: This manager does not support remembered computer-app approvals for this computer.
invalid_response: The manager returned an invalid approvals list. Try again.
revoked: Approval revoked. Persona will ask again the next time it needs this app or screen.
confirm_detail: Persona will ask again the next time it needs this app or screen. This does not stop an operation already in progress.
